ways.time: 4 - 6 days round trip from Freshwater landing
evidence: The track traverses the low-lying Freshwater and Rakeahua Valleys, then heads across to Doughboy and Mason Bay.
The easiest way to start and finish the Southern Circuit is to arrange a water-taxi pick-up or drop-off at Freshwater Landing, Freds Camp or Rakeahua Hut.
The track starts directly opposite Freshwater Hut and travels down the swampy Freshwater valley to Tolson River
Follow the track to the Island Hill homestead and then over flat tussock and mānuka country to Freshwater River and Freshwater Hut.

doubts: DOC's time is 'round trip from Freshwater landing' and the 71.5 km loop matches the sum of the section distances from Freshwater Hut round to Freshwater Hut, so the main loop is recorded starting and ending at Freshwater Hut; Freshwater Landing itself has no entry and is recorded as an access point. The text does not say whether Freds Camp and Rakeahua Hut water-taxi points lead onto anything beyond the circuit. Direction (clockwise/anticlockwise) is not stated; recorded in the order described. W2 (from Halfmoon Bay/Oban) has no total time or distance; its start ref is the Halfmoon Bay / Oban place (T18), since the walk starts at the Rakiura National Park Visitor Centre and follows roads with no matching road end feature. North Arm Hut is passed only on W2, so it is not in huts. Duck Creek has two river entries (T10, T11), so its ref is null.
